faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 use?
faqLeft.a: The Range Rover Sport P530 uses the BMW N63 twin-turbo V8, a 4.4-litre petrol engine introduced with the current L461 generation in 2022.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport P530?
faqLeft.a: The P530 uses the BMW N63 engine. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild BMW N63 Range Rover Sport P530 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We address timing chain wear, valve seal degradation, and coolant system leaks as standard on every N63 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport P530 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport P530 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport P530 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport P530 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
